summary: Integra Resources Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 11, 2026, covering the month of May 2026. The filing includes Management's Discussion and Analysis and unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with related certificates and a news release on first quarter 2026 results. It also incorporates exhibits into existing Form S-8 registration statements. This is a routine periodic report of quarterly operating and financial results, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. There are no dealings or changes of corporate control, strategic alternatives, or capital structure events. The document consists entirely of standard forward-looking language and financial performance disclosure.
